articles.title: Video: "The Diplomat" Season 4 - Official Teaser - Netflix
articles.summary: Netflix has released the official teaser for 'The Diplomat: Season 4', promising intense drama. The new season will explore the breakdown of two marriages and a catastrophic event that shatters the delicate peace established by protagonist Kate Wyler. While this teaser focuses on personal strife, the series typically delves into complex international relations and political maneuvering, presenting situations a diplomat might face amidst global challenges.
